verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents applying rule-defined fixes directly to files with the `--autofix` flag, so developers can apply automatic fixes instead of only reading reports. Marketing also says it can 'Scan and fix' code and covers 'remediation'. missing for 10: in-depth docs on fix behavior and limits (which rules ship fixes, multi-fix handling), documented suggested-fix surfaces such as PR comments or IDE quick-fixes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that autofix works.

support.subject: As a developer, I can apply suggested or automatic code fixes for findings instead of only reading reports

citations.quote: You can apply the Rule-defined fix directly to the file using the `--autofix` flag.
Scan and fix AI-generated code the moment it's written
Combine AI reasoning with rule-based analysis for detection, triage, and remediation
